# Test Document

This is a test document for the Knowledge Base upload feature.

## Overview
The Knowledge Base allows users to upload documents in various formats:
- PDF files
- DOCX files
- Markdown (MD) files
- Plain text (TXT) files

## Benefits
- Centralized knowledge management
- Easy search and discovery
- Tag-based organization
- Team collaboration

This document was created for testing purposes.
